core: TGF-beta and BMP SMAD signalling regulation
qualifier: with miRNA biogenesis control
name: TGF-beta and BMP SMAD signalling with miRNA regulation
rationale: All members concern positive/negative control of TGF-beta/BMP-SMAD signalling or SMAD-linked miRNA transcription and processing; BMP signalling separates it from the TGFBR3/activin and fibrosis neighbours, and miRNA regulation from the cancer-mutant/RUNX3 and NODAL neighbours.

core: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone control of blood pressure and sodium
qualifier: aldosterone and corticosteroid biosynthesis
name: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone control of blood pressure and sodium
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signalling, renal sodium and volume handling, and aldosterone/corticosteroid synthesis and response; the aldosterone/steroidogenic arm distinguishes it from the vasopressin-aquaporin and natriuretic/cGMP blood-pressure neighbours.

qualifier: across neurotransmitter release cycles
name: Synaptic vesicle docking and priming for neurotransmitter release
rationale: All members are vesicle docking, SNARE assembly/priming or the transmitter-specific release cycles built on them; neighbours instead hold calcium-triggered fusion, spontaneous release and presynaptic plasticity.

core: Amino sugar and nucleotide sugar synthesis
qualifier: with Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport and its disorders
name: Amino sugar and nucleotide sugar synthesis and transport
rationale: Members cover UDP-GlcNAc, sialic acid/CMP-Neu5Ac and UDP-glucuronate production plus SLC35/SLC33 nucleotide-sugar transporters and their defects; the transport arm separates it from dolichol/mannose, GPI, glycan-elongation and GDP-fucose neighbours.

qualifier: with eicosanoid and lipid mediator signalling
name: Platelet activation, coagulation and eicosanoid lipid mediators
rationale: Members span the coagulation cascade and its variants, platelet adhesion/activation, vitamin K carboxylation and the eicosanoid/SPM/lipid-GPCR mediator network; the eicosanoid arm distinguishes it from the integrin-platelet neighbour, and haemostasis from glycerolipid, lipoprotein and complement neighbours.

qualifier: beta-oxidation, branched-chain amino acid and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase steps
name: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation, branched-chain amino acid and 2-oxoacid catabolism
rationale: Members are mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, ketone bodies, BCAA/lysine catabolism and PDH/OGDH/BCKDH complexes with their lipoyl, biotin, CoA and carnitine cofactors and inborn errors; BCAA and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase content separates it from the B-vitamin and carnitine-synthesis neighbours.

qualifier: UV, phorbol ester and TNF/PI3K-induced
name: Immediate-early stress response to UV, phorbol ester and TNF
rationale: Members are broad induced-gene responses to UV, PMA, nitric oxide, TNF-NF-kB and growth factors with p38 activation and growth arrest; the UV and PI3K-AKT responses distinguish it from the senescence and AP-1/JNK neighbours.

core: Stress-responsive transcriptional control of central metabolism
qualifier: HIF hypoxia and NRF2 oxidative-stress regulators
name: HIF and NRF2 transcriptional control of glycolytic and redox metabolism
rationale: Members are HIF/oxygen sensing, NRF2 target-gene regulation and p53/mTORC1 control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate and NADP metabolism; HIF and NRF2 transcriptional arms separate it from ROS-detox/ferroptosis, FOXO and plain glycolysis neighbours.

qualifier: ligand binding through FRS/SHC cascades
name: FGFR3 ligand binding and downstream signalling
rationale: Every member is FGFR3-specific (isoform ligand binding, FRS and SHC cascades, activating mutants), whereas all neighbours are the corresponding FGFR1, FGFR2 or FGFR4 modules.

qualifier: germ cell proliferation and sperm flagellar motility
name: Germ cell development and sperm flagellar motility
rationale: Members cover primordial germ cell migration, proliferation, meiosis entry and death, Sertoli barrier and sperm mitochondrial sheath/motility; germ cell specification separates it from axoneme and acrosome neighbours, and sperm motility from gonad/oocyte-maturation neighbours.

qualifier: hexokinase/glucokinase and glucose-6-phosphatase disorders
name: Glucose-6-phosphate formation and hydrolysis in glycogen mobilization
rationale: Members centre on hexokinase/glucokinase phosphorylation, G6PC/SLC37A4 hydrolysis and transport, glycogenolysis and early glycolysis; the hexokinase and glucose-6-phosphatase content separates it from gluconeogenesis/fructose and glycogen-synthesis neighbours.

qualifier: sorafenib, ponatinib, crenolanib, lestaurtinib set
name: FLT3 mutants resistant to sorafenib, ponatinib, crenolanib, lestaurtinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to a named TKI; the specific drugs separate it from the other FLT3-resistance set (gilteritinib, midostaurin, quizartinib), KIT resistance and FLT3 signalling neighbours.

qualifier: nephric duct origin, elongation and branching
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching
rationale: All members concern nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching; neighbours instead hold kidney size/metanephric mesenchyme control or intermediate mesoderm induction.

qualifier: global-genome excision and error-free POLH bypass
name: UV lesion repair by global-genome excision and POLH bypass
rationale: Members are GG-NER recognition and incision, pyrimidine dimer repair and POLH error-free translesion synthesis; incision steps and POLH separate it from gap-filling, error-prone TLS and TC-NER neighbours.

qualifier: to NF-kB and type I interferon production
name: RIG-I-like receptor signalling to NF-kB and type I interferon
rationale: All members are RLR/MDA-5 antiviral signalling and its NF-kB and IFN-alpha/beta outputs; neighbours emphasise negative regulators, dsRNA response, IRF3/7 activation or viral evasion.

qualifier: fatty acids and eicosanoids
name: Cytochrome P450 oxidation of fatty acids and eicosanoids
rationale: The three members are the cytochrome P450 substrate-class groupings (fatty acids, eicosanoids, miscellaneous); neighbours are specific eicosanoid branch pathways (epoxygenase, COX, 12-LOX, 5-LOX).

core: Viral RNA replication and host restriction
qualifier: coronavirus replicase and APOBEC3G cytidine deamination
name: Coronavirus RNA replication and APOBEC3G cytidine-deamination restriction
rationale: Members are coronavirus replication/translation (replicase, capping, frameshifting, NMD/IFIT evasion) and host restriction by APOBEC3G C-to-U editing; coronavirus content separates it from ADAR editing, and APOBEC3G from generic viral translation neighbours.

qualifier: with eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2 permeability
name: Endothelial shear-stress mechanotransduction and eNOS trafficking
rationale: Members are endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory flow via PIEZO1/PECAM1/KDR plus eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2 permeability; the eNOS/VEGFR2 arm separates it from osteocyte mechanosensing, vascular smooth muscle and integrin neighbours.

qualifier: hepatobiliary ABCB4/ABCB11 bile secretion
name: Membrane lipid translocation and hepatobiliary bile acid secretion
rationale: Members are aminophospholipid/sphingolipid translocation and ABCB4/ABCB11-driven bile secretion; bile secretion separates it from flippase-trafficking modules, and lipid translocation from lipoprotein/sterol and xenobiotic transport neighbours.

qualifier: complex N-glycan maturation and mucin-type O-glycosylation
name: Golgi N-glycan maturation and mucin-type O-glycan synthesis
rationale: Members are complex/hybrid N-glycan trimming and antenna elongation, GalNAc-type O-glycosylation and its disorders, sialylation and polyLacNAc; these separate it from fucose/blood-group neighbours and ER N-glycan processing.

qualifier: fork reversal, R-loops and protein-DNA crosslinks
name: Replication fork stress, DNA topology and protein-DNA crosslink repair
rationale: Members are DNA topological change, fork reversal, R-loop processing, protein-DNA crosslink repair and responses to camptothecin and hydroxyurea; these replication-stress lesions separate it from checkpoint, recombination and telomere neighbours.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide responses and ferroptosis
name: Peroxide-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis regulation
rationale: Members concern cell responses to hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides and regulation of oxidative-stress apoptosis and ferroptosis; ferroptosis and peroxide response separate it from nitrosative, hypoxic-ischaemic and respiration-control neighbours.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
qualifier: ALK/LTK family
name: ALK/LTK tyrosine kinase signalling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are tyrosine autophosphorylation and downstream PI3K-AKT/ERK activation with ALK/LTK ligand signalling; the ALK/LTK and PI3K-AKT content separates it from oncogenic RTK fusions, PTK6, MET and EPO receptor neighbours.

qualifier: with nucleotide phosphorylation and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Nucleoside and nucleobase transport with nucleotide phosphorylation
rationale: Members cover plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transporters (incl. nucleoside-analogue drugs), nucleotide kinase interconversion and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport; the transport arm separates it from creatine neighbours and the phosphorylation arm from NUDT/thiopurine catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: dendritic, T and plasma cells
name: Dendritic, T and plasma cell surface signatures
rationale: Members are surface/enrichment signatures of dendritic, CD4 T and plasma cells with butyrophilin interactions; DC, T and plasma cell content separates it from monocyte, B cell and T cell activation neighbours.
